from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

img = Image.open('radiograph.jpg')

x_min, y_min = int(0.60*w), int(0.60*h)
x_max, y_max = int(0.72*w), int(0.82*h)

crop = img.crop((x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(crop)

cw, ch = crop.size

# Draw grid lines every 20 pixels with normalized coordinates relative to original image
for x in range(0, cw, 40):
    orig_x = (x_min + x) / w
    draw.line([(x, 0), (x, ch)], fill='red', width=1)
    draw.text((x+2, 5), f'{orig_x:.3f}', fill='red')

for y in range(0, ch, 40):
    orig_y = (y_min + y) / h
    draw.line([(0, y), (cw, y)], fill='red', width=1)
    draw.text((5, y+2), f'{orig_y:.3f}', fill='red')
